From L-R: Pramila Devi, maternal grandmother, Sanyukta Devi and Ram Nath Mahto alias Ramu Mahto, parents of Hritik Kumar alias Roushan Kumar, one of three arrested in attack on Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff, seen in Bihar on October 29, 2026. | Photo Credit: Amarnath Tewary
The family of one of the three arrested youngsters involved in the attack on Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff on October 18, 2026, first came to know about the incident when the local Ratanpur police of Bihar’s Begusarai District visited their shop next day forenoon to confirm their credentials.
On October 29, eleven days after the incident, when The Hindu visited the family-owned shop of Hritik Kumar alias Roushan (22), one of three alleged shooters who had fired upon Tiger Shroff on his car outside the Pushpa park in Juhu, the family were in utter “disbelief and discomfort” to know about the incident in which their eldest of four children is currently in police custody. They were busy at their shop and do not subscribe newspapers so, they said, they were “unaware of the incident and implication of their innocent child in the high-profile incident in which big people are involved.”
